title: The Empty Berth
text: The pad is ringed and lit and empty. The clamps stand open. In the dust are the marks of something heavy that sat here a long time, then left. The depot's log terminal still has power.

lines.speaker: Depot log
lines.text: CACHE 07 · ACCORD · held. CACHE 07 · re-routed · T−61 min · trajectory THALASSA · authority: (none)
"An hour. It left an hour before we got here. And the authority field isn't wiped. It's blank. As if it never needed one."

choices.label: Ask Engram about it
choices.reply: You send one line to Kora: did you take our cache?

choices.label: Log it
choices.reply: Logged: one supply cache, ours, gone to Thalassa.

notes: STORY.md §12: the one time Meridian's rigging reaches Accord. Asking rather than accusing: engram +1.
